guides.title: Gel Polish
paragraphs: Professional gel polish designed for intense colour, brilliant shine and reliable long-lasting wear. Our formulas cure smoothly without wrinkling and remove cleanly with professional technique. It is VERY IMPORTANT to note that our products are TPO & HEMA Free which means that curing time is increased.  Cure: 60–90s 48W UV/LED
Explore over 1,000 shades across Solid Gel Polish, Cat Eye, Glitters, Jelly and Glass Effect finishes — with new seasonal collections added regularly.
All gel polishes are cruelty-free and approved by Cruelty Free International under the global Leaping Bunny programme.
application: Prepare the nails with a dry manicure
Apply Superbond and allow to dry with air for 30 seconds.
Carefully apply a thin layer of Base coat avoiding the cuticles. Cure: 60–90s 48W UV/LED
Starting at the base of the nail and moving towards the free end, apply a thin layer of  gel polish. Cure: 60–90s 48W UV/LED
If needed apply a second layer again with the same technique.  Cure: 60–90s 48W UV/LED

guides.title: Brush On Builder (BIAB)
paragraphs: Brush On Builder is a builder in a bottle (BIAB) — a self-levelling builder gel that applies directly from the bottle to strengthen, shape, and perfect natural nails with effortless control.
application: Prepare your nails for a dry manicure.
Apply Superbond and let it dry on its own for a few seconds.
Apply a thin layer of Classic/ Flexi or 5-in-1 Superior Base Coat Clear.   Cure: 60–90s 48W UV/LED
Apply thin, even coats of Brush on Builder Reinforced Base and make sure to seal the nail tips properly without making contact with the the cuticles.  Cure: 60–90s 48W UV/LED
Continue to apply your colour and finish with top coat

guides.title: Liquid Polygel
paragraphs: Liquid Polygel is designed for strengthening, covering and extending medium-length nails with ease and precision. Its smooth, moderate-flow consistency allows for effortless application and excellent control, helping to reduce working time while achieving a clean, professional result.

Ideal for the "no-file technique", it levels beautifully without running, making it suitable for both natural nail reinforcement and short-to-medium extensions. It can be combined with different colours, nail art and designs, giving nail technicians endless creative possibilities.
application: Prepare your nails for a dry manicure.
Apply Superbond and let it dry on its own for a few seconds.
Apply a thin layer of Classic/ Flexi or 5-in-1 Superior Base Coat Clear.   Cure: 60–90s 48W UV/LED
Continue to apply your colour and finish with top coat
points: Ideal for strengthening, covering and extending nails

guides.title: Premium Fibreglass Builder Gel
paragraphs: The GEL.IT.UP 3-in-1 Premium is a fiberglass builder gel — a single-phase builder gel enriched with fiberglass fibres for exceptional structural strength and long-lasting durability.

This fiberglass builder gel is suitable for natural nail reinforcement as well as extensions. It applies cleanly, does not run, and does not yellow. No separate base coat is required before application.
Ideal for technicians who need predictable structure, maximum adhesion control, and professional-grade durability across all service types.
application: Preparation: Perform a thorough dry manicure and cleanse the nail plate.
Adhesion: Apply Superbond Primer and air-dry for 30 seconds.
Foundation: Apply a thin slip layer over nail/form (do not cure).
Building: Place a larger bead centrally and guide to edges/apex as it self-levels.
Cure: 60–90s 48W UV/LED
Refinement & Finish: Wipe inhibition layer, file shape, then final gloss layer or proceed with GEL.IT.UP by GIUP® color.
points: Key Benefits: Fiberglass-reinforced strength, single-phase efficiency, cool-cure comfort, and 100% HEMA/TPO-free performance.
Dual Forms Application — Prep and prime as standard, then apply a thin slip layer of 3-in-1 Premium Builder Gel.
Dual Forms Application — Select the correct dual form size, place a controlled bead in the form, and spread evenly to avoid trapped air.
Dual Forms Application — Press form from cuticle toward free edge, flash cure to lock position, then full-cure and gently remove the form before refinement.

guides.title: Multimix Synthogel (Polygel)
paragraphs: Its high-quality formula combines the advantages of acrylic and gel, making it extremely durable. It offers the strength of acrylic with the ease of use of builder gels.
It can be used for natural nail reinforcement as well as for extensions. It does not run during application, is odorless, and does not cause a burning sensation during curing.
Application can be done using Dual Form Nail Tips, Nail Forms, or with a freehand technique.
application: Perform a standard dry manicure and cleanse the nail plate.
Apply Superbond Primer and air-dry for 30 seconds.
Apply a thin layer of 5-in-1 Superior Base and Cure: 60–90s 48W UV/LED
Place a small quantity of the MultiMix Synthogel and position with a spatula onto the nail plate.
Use a brush with All-In-One Liquid (lightly) to pat and smooth; product remains workable until cured.
Cure: 60–90s 48W UV/LED
Wipe sticky layer, file to shape, and finish with GEL.IT.UP by GIUP® color or top coat.
points: Key Benefits: Hybrid strength, zero-gravity feel, odorless environment, and 100% HEMA/TPO-free clean science standard.
